column1: # Labelled reading of the problems each RL model gets right and its base gets wrong. ``Wins'' counts such problems among the $300$ with stored texts ($150$ physics and $150$ MATH-500)
column2: under the rule of the protocol above. ``Losses'' counts the reverse. \S\ref{sec:reach} counts physics wins alone
column3: under the stricter rule that the other model finished all eight samples and got all eight wrong. ``New in that sample'' counts wins whose RL derivation states a principle
column4: method or reading that the read base sample never states. ``In a base sample'' counts those found in at least one of the base's four samples on the same problem. Open-RS3 is the chance-level reference. Rows are grouped by base.
